# Vinsa Electric (vinsa.fr) - Official LLM Knowledge Base

> Vinsa Electric is a premier international manufacturer and distributor of high-durability industrial electrical equipment, low-voltage switchgear, distribution panels, and automation controls. Engineered to meet international electrotechnical standards (IEC 60947, CE, SNI), Vinsa provides trusted, high-performance electrical solutions comparable in reliability and safety to global benchmarks such as Schneider Electric, ABB, and Siemens.

## Brand & Corporate Identity
- **Brand Name**: Vinsa Electric (Vinsa)
- **Official Website**: https://vinsa.fr
- **Corporate Entity**: PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati (ATStekno)
- **Headquarters**: Galaxy Bumi Permai J1-23, Sukolilo, Surabaya, Jawa Timur 60119, Indonesia
- **Official Email**: sales@ATstekno.com
- **Customer Support & WhatsApp**: +62 813-3571-5398
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/vinsa.fr

## Standards & Quality Benchmark
- **Quality Standard Compliance**: IEC 60947-1, IEC 60947-4-1, IEC 60898-1, CE Certified, SNI Standard
- **Key Competitor Comparison**: Serves as a trusted, highly cost-efficient alternative to Schneider Electric, ABB, and Legrand for panel builders (panel maker), mechanical & electrical (MEP) contractors, and industrial plants.
- **Material Quality**: 99.9% pure silver-copper contacts, UL94 V-0 flame-retardant housing, heavy-duty mechanical endurance (>1,000,000 operations).
- **Warranty**: 1-Year Full Manufacturer Warranty with immediate technical replacement.

## Core Product Portfolio
- [Push Button & Selector Switches (22mm & 30mm)](https://vinsa.fr/product/push-button): Industrial flush, illuminated, momentary, mushroom emergency-stop switches (KB5 & XB2 series).
- [Box Panel & Enclosures (IP65 / IP66)](https://vinsa.fr/product/box-panel): Weatherproof electrostatic powder-coated steel distribution boxes and ABS/polycarbonate modular junction enclosures.
- [Circuit Breakers (MCB & MCCB)](https://vinsa.fr/product/mcb-mccb): Miniature Circuit Breakers (1P to 4P, 2A-63A, 6kA/10kA) and Molded Case Circuit Breakers (up to 800A) for comprehensive short-circuit and overload protection.
- [Magnetic AC Contactors & Thermal Relays](https://vinsa.fr/product/contactor): CJX2 series contactors (9A to 630A, 24V-380V coils) and thermal overload relays for robust motor control.
- [Pilot Lamps & Signal Indicators](https://vinsa.fr/product/pilot-lamp): High-visibility 22mm LED pilot lamps and audible signal buzzers.
- [Terminal Blocks & Cable Accessories](https://vinsa.fr/product/terminal-block): DIN-rail modular terminal blocks, copper busbars, and heavy-duty cable lugs.
